Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. NEW FORMAT: Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Joyce Hunter, and Darrell Yates Rist 2. US State Dept requires employees to take HIV antibody test, disallowing those positive from working abroad 3. Vermont put $150,000 to educate state about AIDS, NYC Board of Education produces a public school film "Sex, Drugs, and AIDS" 4. Kentucky state county judge ruled that Sodomy Laws violate the Kentucky state constitution 5.Discussion of a National Gay and Lesbian March on Washington DC, Oct 11th 1987 6. Discussion of the New York Times' playing down the threat of AIDS infection for heterosexual couples, and misrepresentation of the statistical facts of infection COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 7. Andy Humm on Cary Grant's lawsuit against Chevy Chase COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 8. Continuing coverage of the 2nd annual meeting of gay and lesbian elected officials in Washington, DC 9. National Association of Gay and Lesbian Democratic Clubs to remain part of the party despite 53% voting to remove Democratic affiliation 10. Mood of the gay and lesbian leaders, and need for a national leader like Harvey Milk 11. Gay politicians agree to back the March in Washington DC COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 12. News Brief, announcements 13. Belle Glade, Florida, study finds high rate of AIDS infections due to sexual contact and IV drug use 14. Georgia Fraternal Order of Police Officers tries to ban homosexuals from joining the force 15. Gay man forced to resign from Canadian Mounted Police sues the department 16. Man banned from seeing his child due to positive HTLVIII test appeals the court's decision 17. Announcement of film "Rights and Reactions" 18. Sports Report, with clips from the 1986 Gay Games 19. Closing credits over news clips of tennis star Boris Becker
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, with clips from "Escape from Alcatraz" 3. Announcement of Cary Grant's death and homosexual rumors, with clips 4. Richard Pryor's Barbara Walters' special on question of AIDS status, with clips
